query: UPDATE photos SET width=$3,height=$4,orientation=1,original_orientation=$5,is_hdr=$6,has_gain_map=$6,icc_name=$7,camera_make=$8,camera_model=$9,lens=$10,focal_mm=$11,aperture=$12,shutter=$13,iso=$14,gps_lat=CASE WHEN gps_overridden THEN gps_lat ELSE $15 END,gps_lon=CASE WHEN gps_overridden THEN gps_lon ELSE $16 END,taken_at=coalesce(taken_at_override,$17),dominant_colors=$18,placeholder=$19,kind=CASE WHEN $20 THEN 'raw'::media_kind ELSE kind END,status='ready',failure_reason=NULL,derivative_plan=$21,taken_at_local=CASE WHEN taken_at_override IS NOT NULL THEN taken_at_override AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ELSE $22 END WHERE id=$1 AND original_hash=$2 AND generation=$23 AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING gps_lat,gps_lon,place_overridden,place_id
